editorial_thesis: Today’s practical advantage is evidence hygiene: preserve document fidelity before enrichment, make agent state recoverable and private, and ship consequential claims with an inspectable verification trail.

topic_groups.title: Private Document Intelligence
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A deliberately under-covered self-hosted knowledge lane: a fresh Paperless maintenance release fixes AI-suggestion cache isolation and document-processing behavior, while MarkItDown improves structured conversion at the ingestion edge.

sources.title: Paperless-ngx v3.0.5
sources.why_selected: Model/endpoint-keyed suggestion caching matters whenever a client archive has multiple providers, a staging endpoint, or a local model beside a hosted one.
sources.usefulness: Run a client-safe, self-hosted archive for contracts, invoices, briefs, and project evidence; keep retrieval and document metadata under the workspace’s control.

sources.title: MarkItDown v0.1.7
sources.why_selected: Presentation and equation fidelity determine whether an extraction pipeline is usable as source material for review, search, or agents.
sources.usefulness: Put a local conversion step in front of Buildn/client knowledge ingestion; retain the original file plus generated Markdown as separate artifacts.

sources.title: Paperless-ngx AI suggestion documentation
sources.why_selected: It supplies the operating context for the cache-isolation fix: suggestions should enrich an archive’s metadata, not become the archive of record.
sources.usefulness: Define client-specific document types and custom fields first; add suggestions only after a human can review and correct every proposed label.

topic_groups.title: Durable Agent State + Local Privacy
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Agent controls were covered yesterday; today’s distinct operational signal is durability below the model layer—recoverable state, dead-lettered channel ingress, and owner-only histories/logs.

sources.title: OpenClaw 2026.7.2 beta.6
sources.why_selected: This is a concrete reference architecture for the hard part of agent operations: avoiding silent loss between intake, persistence, restart, and human review.
sources.usefulness: Use its failure modes as an acceptance checklist for Buildn/client agents that accept Slack, Telegram, or web requests and create durable work artifacts.

sources.title: rtk v0.44.2
sources.why_selected: Local developer and agent tooling can expose prompts, paths, commands, and audit records through filesystem defaults long before a network control fails.
sources.usefulness: Audit workstations and runners for histories, temporary output, run logs, and artifacts; make restrictive permissions part of bootstrap and upgrade checks.

sources.title: OpenClaw release notes: approvals and MCP Apps
sources.why_selected: Durable state is most valuable when it preserves an accountable handoff: a question, an approval, a tool request, and the resulting artifact.
sources.usefulness: Model a client-facing agent surface as ticketed work with bounded context, an explicit approver, and an auditable result rather than as an unconstrained chat session.

topic_groups.title: Proof-Carrying Research Outputs
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A fresh research release earns a deliberately non-product lane because it publishes not only claims, but papers, narrated reasoning, Lean certificates, and instructions for independent checking—an unusually practical pattern for evidence-heavy work.

sources.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
sources.why_selected: It is a rare public example of a model-generated research result bundled with multiple inspection layers rather than a benchmark headline alone.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the release pattern for Buildn research or client recommendations: claim, source corpus, assumptions, reproducible derivation, reviewer notes, and a verification path.

sources.title: openai/ten-proofs Lean certificates
sources.why_selected: A certificate repository turns “trust us” into an artifact that a separate toolchain can build and inspect.
sources.usefulness: For software or analysis, keep critical acceptance evidence beside the deliverable: tests, fixtures, build command, checksums, and a reviewer-readable summary.

sources.title: OpenAI proof paper
sources.why_selected: Separating exposition from verification gives expert reviewers a readable entry point without making prose the sole evidence object.
sources.usefulness: Publish client-facing explanations alongside structured evidence rather than forcing non-technical stakeholders to inspect raw telemetry, code, or model traces.

sources.title: Reasoning walkthroughs
sources.why_selected: Process artifacts let reviewers assess the route to a conclusion, not only the final polished result.
sources.usefulness: Have agents preserve concise decision logs—sources consulted, alternatives rejected, tests run, and tool calls made—alongside final recommendations.
